summary: Build/upgrade an electrician services website with clear service pages, professional visuals, simple navigation, strong CTAs, responsive design, SEO, reviews/social proof, and performance/security (SSL).
architectural_notes: Site information architecture should include top-level pages: Home, Services, About Us, Contact, with optional individual service detail pages under Services.
CTA elements should be consistently visible across pages (header/hero and/or sticky actions on mobile).
SEO metadata (titles/descriptions) and image alt text should be managed per page/service.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Professional team photo, electrician team portrait (team-photo.dim_1200x800.jpg)
- Electrician working on home wiring, indoor residential setting (service-home-wiring.dim_800x600.jpg)
- Emergency electrical repair scene with electrician fixing a fault safely (service-emergency-repairs.dim_800x600.jpg)
- Modern electrical panel/fuse box upgrade scene (service-fuse-panel-upgrades.dim_800x600.jpg)
- LED light fitting installation scene, clean modern interior (service-led-light-fitting.dim_800x600.jpg)
- Appliance installation scene, electrician installing a household appliance connection (service-appliance-installation.dim_800x600.jpg)

existing_features.title: Update the primary navigation to include only these menu items: Home | Services | About Us | Contact. Ensure both desktop and mobile navigation reflect this and that clicking each item smoothly scrolls to the correct section.

Make the Services offering easy to understand by presenting these services as clearly separated service entries (either as sub-sections within the Services section and/or as dedicated detail views): Home Wiring, Emergency Repairs, Fuse/Panel Upgrades, Light Fitting/LED Work, Appliance Installation. Each service entry must have a title, a short description, an icon, and a professional image.

Add prominent CTAs across the site so users can take action from every major section (Home/Hero, Services, About Us, Contact): “Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, and “Call Us”. The “Call Us” CTA must use the existing phone number and a tel: link.

Implement a floating, always-available contact CTA component that improves conversions on mobile and desktop (e.g., a compact floating bar or buttons) with at least: Call and WhatsApp actions. Ensure it does not block key content or form fields.

Add a customer reviews / social proof section that displays multiple testimonials with names and star ratings. Place it in a sensible location in the single-page flow (e.g., after Services and before Contact) and ensure it is visually consistent with the rest of the site.

Implement basic on-page SEO improvements: set a keyword-focused page title and meta description (English), and ensure key images have meaningful alt text. Use the provided example format for the title as guidance.

Improve performance for fast loading by optimizing image loading behavior and preventing unnecessarily heavy above-the-fold assets. Use sensible defaults such as lazy-loading below-the-fold images and ensuring images are appropriately sized for their display containers.
Ensure the site is served securely without mixed content: all external links opened from CTAs (e.g., WhatsApp) must use https URLs, and there must be no http resource references in the frontend.

Add the new professional images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and wire them into the Hero/Services/About (team) areas where appropriate, using consistent styling and captions/alt text in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a clear Services list with each service as its own section and/or dedicated page (Home wiring, Emergency repairs, Fuse/Panel upgrades, Light fitting/LED work, Appliance installation)
Add professional images and service icons (high-quality electrician/work photos, team photo) to visually highlight services
Implement simple top navigation menu: Home | Services | About Us | Contact
Add prominent call-to-action buttons across pages (Get a Free Quote, Book Now, Call Us)
Ensure fully mobile-friendly / responsive design across screen sizes
Implement SEO basics: optimized page titles/meta descriptions with keywords, image alt tags, and service page SEO
Add customer reviews / social proof section (testimonials, star ratings, and/or Google reviews)
Improve fast loading and security: image optimization/performance and HTTPS/SSL enabled

projectName: Improve electrician website: clear services, navigation, CTAs, SEO, reviews, and performance
